name: Air Elementaling
description: An elementaling is a manifestation of an element that is lacking sentience, often the result of primordial magic. They commonly present in their raw elemental form but shape themselves to emulate certain creatures such as humanoids or beasts.

actions.name: Charge
actions.description: In response to taking lightning damage, even if it is completely mitigated, the Air Elementaling immediately uses an action.

actions.name: Buffeting Blow
actions.description: The Air Elementaling strikes out with an attack amplified by wind, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, medium and smaller creatures are shoved back 2 units, even if the attack deals no damage after mitigations.

actions.name: Extended Blow
actions.description: When using the Buffeting Blow action, the Air Elementaling extends the attack to a different creature that is adjacent to it.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Air
traits.description: If the Air Elementaling does not move or attack for one minute, it becomes invisible until it makes its next attack.
